company_name: Henan Xinlianxin Shenleng Energy Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — Henan Xinlianxin Shenleng Energy Co., Ltd. produces high-purity gases essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Henan Xinlianxin Shenleng Energy Co., Ltd. specializes in the production of high-purity gases, including electronic-grade carbon dioxide and carbon monoxide, which are critical for various semiconductor applications. With over 40 years in the gas industry, the company offers one-stop gas solutions tailored for the semiconductor sector and other high-tech industries.
capabilities: High-purity carbon dioxide for semiconductor processes

regional_presence.China: The company has five production bases across various provinces in China, including Henan and Xinjiang, and exports to nearly 20 countries.
